content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've created a web server for [product_name] [version_no]. It's working well for monitoring values, but I can't modify any values. Also, I can only log in to it on the same local network; attempting access from other networks fails. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Split from [product_name] [version_no] Web Server Safari IPHONE IPAD.

Hello, If you enable parameter modification in the message text, you can also modify parameters via the web server. Click on the parameter to change it. For modifying VM-Memory, use the variable table within the web server. Hope this helps.
Hello, You can modify values from items such as markers (Mx, Ix, or Ox).

analysis.insight_summary: Users are able to set up and monitor values using the [product_name] [version_no] web server interface, but are unable to modify values as expected. Additionally, remote access outside the local network is unsuccessful. The responses clarify that certain values (such as markers and I/O) can be changed if permitted, but the original question suggests some features or restrictions are unclear to users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to adjust system values directly from the [product_name] [version_no] web server and to access the server from networks outside their local one.
